## About
Vina Automobile Inc. is a repair shop at 5103 W Ocotillo Rd in Glendale, run by Tam and his son as a family business. Our specialty started with Japanese vehicles, and today we service and repair both import and domestic cars.
We work on engines, transmissions, suspension, air conditioning and electrical systems, with a Master Technician in charge. Customers tell us they appreciate being treated with care and honesty, and not being charged for work they didn't need.
We're rated 4.3 on Google from 66 reviews. If you're new to us, tell us what's going on with your car and we'll be happy to help.

## Services
- Engine and transmission work: We work on engines and transmissions for import and domestic vehicles.
- Suspension, air conditioning and electrical: We also work on suspension, car AC and electrical systems.
- Parts with lifetime warranty: Many common parts, like alternators, starters, water pumps, ceramic brake pads and radiators, carry a lifetime warranty.
- Labor on parts you bring: Already have the part? Bring your own parts and we'll do the labor to install them for you.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: We started out specializing in Japanese vehicles and now service domestic cars as well, so both imports and domestics are welcome.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Give us a call or send an email, and we'll give you an estimate and our advice on what your car needs.

Q: Is there anything nearby while I wait?
A: We don't have a fancy waiting room, but Old Town Glendale is right down the street if you'd like to grab a meal or browse the shops during a shorter repair.
